resources.string: DiaPilot is not a medical device. It is a personal logbook and research tool that shows your own data.
It never suggests or calculates an insulin dose. Every decision about insulin, food and treatment is yours and your care team\'s.
Alerts are hints, not a guarantee: they depend on a sensor, a phone and a data chain that can all stop. Confirm a low or a high with a meter before acting.
Your data stays on this phone unless you export it yourself.
I have read this and I understand that the app gives no medical advice.
You can change this later under More.
Optional. Used for the starting estimate of how much 10 g of carbohydrate raises your glucose; the estimate is inverse to weight. Empty means the 70 kg reference.
Enter a weight between 20 and 300 kg, or leave the field empty.

How far ONE unit of rapid insulin lowers your glucose when nothing else is acting — the number your care team may call the correction factor. Most adults are between %1$s and %2$s per unit; children and very insulin-sensitive people are higher.
Units for this field and for the whole app
Enter your ISF between %1$s and %2$s per unit. Without it the forecast stays off.
How fast does your insulin act?
A starting shape for the action curve, in minutes after the injection: when it starts, when it is strongest, when it is over. It only has to be roughly right — your own doses refine it later.
Rapid analog, typical (NovoRapid, Humalog, Apidra). Not sure? Use this.
Optional. How much 10 g of carbohydrate raises your glucose with no insulin acting. Empty means the estimate from your weight: %1$s per 10 g.
Enter a rise between %1$s and %2$s per 10 g, or leave the field empty.
Carb rise: from weight, %1$s per 10 g

The insulin action shape is measured from your own doses over time and shown next to these values under More → Personal model. The forecast, What-if and the predictive alerts start from these numbers.
Everything here can be changed under More.
No forecast, What-if or predictive alert runs until you enter your ISF and insulin timing. Alerts on the readings themselves — low, high, rapid fall, no data — keep working.
ISF %1$s per unit · insulin starts %2$d, strongest %3$d, over by %4$d min. The action shape is measured from your own doses over time.
ISF %1$s per unit, entered by hand. The action shape is measured from your own doses over time.
Insulin action measured from your doses
%1$d doses on %2$d days. ISF %3$s per unit is still your hand-entered value.
Empty: the estimate from weight above applies.
